title: Marvelous Designer 2025.2: New Feature Overview
description:
More Options, Greater Control: Marvelous Designer 2025.2

Learn more about the new update: https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/product/newfeature

Update to unlock five new key features designed to enhance realism, efficiency, and creative expression.

✨ What’s New?

Version 2025.2 introduces new animation capabilities, workflow quality of life improvements, and garment creation tools that empower artist control in Marvelous Designer. 

Key Features in Marvelous Designer 2025.2:
📌Convert Patterns to Trims and Accessories
📌MetaHuman DNA Importer
📌Keyable Properties Expansion
📌EveryWear Export with FBX
📌Pleat Creation Tool

… and so much more!
